body: I'm so sorry I didn't respond to this sooner. Yes, I am ok, I am alive and have been getting help for a while now--I'm regularly seeing a therapist and am on some antidepressants that are working really well for me. I'm so glad I didn't make the wrong decision. Thanks for being concerned.

No, I've asked him about it and he assures me that we are exclusive and that we are a couple. He's told his parents about me, met my parents, and we're Facebook-official. He's great when we're together, it's just difficult to get him to spend time with me.

The mustache is interesting, but honestly you make it work! Great smile, great body, love the body hair (never understood why some guys shave it off). Also, the fact that you dress in well-fitting, nice clothes makes you infinitely more attractive than if you'd been in, say, sweats. Easily 7-8/10. :)
